q: The quantum Merlin-Arthur (QMA) class and its relationship to 2-QMA (two-prover QMA): it is known that:
exp: Kobayashi-Matsumoto (2003): 2-QMA = NEXP. Having two separate quantum provers (who cannot communicate) dramatically increases power compared to one quantum prover (QMA ⊆ PSPACE). This is the quantum analogue of the classical MIP = NEXP result.
